If you need to draft a template for informing a client or customer about the delay of their courier or package, below is a professional and polite example you can use or customize based on your specific situation:

---

**Subject:** Update on Your Courier/Package Delivery  

Dear [Recipient's Name],  

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you about a delay regarding the delivery of your courier/package, which was originally scheduled for delivery on [original delivery date]. Due to [reason for the delay, e.g., unforeseen circumstances, increased demand, weather disruptions, or logistical issues], your package has been delayed.  

We understand how important timely delivery is for you, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Please be assured that we are actively working to resolve this delay and ensure your package is delivered as soon as possible.  

Your updated delivery date is now anticipated to be on or before [new delivery date]. You can track the status of your delivery at [tracking link or website] using your tracking number: [tracking number].   

If you have any further questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to reach out to our customer service team at [customer service email or phone number]. Our team is here to assist you.  

We truly appreciate your patience and understanding while we work to deliver your package to you. Thank you for choosing [Company Name].  

Kind regards,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Company Name]  
[Contact Information]  

---

This is a professional and transparent template. Be sure to modify it according to the context of your delay and personalize it with any additional details you think might be relevant.
